description: <<- removes a combining mark together with the indentation space it follows
notes: The spec says the minimum number of leading spaces is removed from each line, which would give " x\n\u0301y\n". hashicorp/hcl removes that many grapheme clusters (flushHeredocTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go uses textseg.ScanGraphemeClusters), and a space followed by a combining mark is one cluster, so the mark is removed too.
